integrity: Mathematical proof includes an explicit simplicial contiguity retraction and dominated-vertex simplicial collapses. Finite exact checks are reproducible from verify.py. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only fully bidirected two-edge pendant ears with two fresh vertices and no other incidents are treated. An arbitrary base digraph may have directed cycles. The explicit integral homology shift does not compute the base homology. Reversal symmetry is asserted for reverse-closed bases; the once-subdivided star theorem concerns its indicated symmetry subgroup. Finite checker tests do not prove the universal result or novelty.
title: Equivariant pendant-ear suspension for multipath complexes of arbitrary digraphs
